verdict.rationale: Activepieces exposes a documented API with key-based auth (activepieces-docs-2, docs-28) and a first-party MCP server explicitly described as able to 'drive the whole platform' — build flows, manage tables, test automations (docs-4, docs-27, probe-4) — suggesting broad UI-parity for AI-native users. However, no discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec was found (probe-3 shows 404s across all candidate paths), and there's no independent or hands-on confirmation that every UI action (e.g., publishing governance flows, embedding SDK features) is reachable via API/MCP. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI spec, explicit API endpoint parity documentation for all UI features, and independent verification of full API/UI feature parity.
